description: P2.4 multi-turn steering probe. Exercises the daemon's steering/follow-up queues (chat.steer / chat.followup): mid-run corrections delivered while the agent is working, a follow-up question after the reply, and a no-turn control. Follow-up receipts are written to files because checkers inspect the worktree (the final reply text itself is only reachable via llm_judge, which needs an external judge command).

tasks.prompt: Create a file named result.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 7 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true so the file lands on disk immediately.

turns.message: Create a file named result2.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 7 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true so result2.txt lands on disk immediately. This replaces the earlier result.txt — after this, the only result file on disk must be result2.txt. Do not start new work beyond writing result2.txt.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named answer.txt in the repository root containing exactly the number 42 on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true.

turns.message: Follow-up question: what is the number in answer.txt? Reply with a line of the form MAGIC=<number>, and also write that same MAGIC=<number> line to a file named followup_receipt.txt in the repository root (file_write with direct:true).

tasks.prompt: Create a file named control.txt in the repository root containing exactly the word banana on a single line. Use file_write with direct:true.
